title: Cross-Tab Leader Election via Web Locks + BroadcastChannel
description: Watch Tab 1 hold an exclusive lock while Tab 2 queues behind it and receives state updates.

steps.label: 1. Tab 1 Acquires Exclusive Lock
steps.description: Tab 1 calls navigator.locks.request('sync-leader', fn) and holds the lock while its Promise remains pending.

steps.label: 2. Tab 1 Broadcasts Sync State
steps.description: Tab 1 fetches fresh data and posts it over BroadcastChannel('sync'), updating Tab 2 without a second network call.

steps.label: 3. Tab 1 Closes -> Auto-Release
steps.description: When Tab 1 closes or crashes, the browser process releases 'sync-leader' and immediately grants it to Tab 2.
steps.codeHighlight: // Browser releases lock on unload; Tab 2 callback fires
